notes.title: Incoming Flashlight, Lighting Updates and Some Minor Updates
notes.content:
First off, I apologize for the inconvenience that I've caused. Later today you guys can expect an update to the game's lighting as well as a flashlight in the bedroom closet. When I first saw the complaints, I assumed that the issue was a matter of preference. I realized that, in actuality, I'm an idiot and the issue is different monitors have different brightness. I am a solo developer; I didn't have playtesting or anything like that before-hand and I just got used to everything, I guess.

Anyway, after this update is live. If there's anything too dark just send me a screenshot in the community section and I'll fix it.
